summary: OmniTools provides a browser-based suite of utilities for handling common file and text manipulation tasks. It bundles functions for working with code, images, videos, documents and data sets into a single interface.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers or system administrators who frequently need a quick, local utility to convert, edit, or format various file types without relying on external web services.
watchOut: The software is at an early release stage and bundles many distinct utilities into one codebase, which may increase the attack surface or contain edge-case bugs in individual tools.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based web application, you will typically need to configure a reverse proxy for TLS termination and mount persistent volumes if any of the tools require local file storage.
